description: This file contains shell script compatibility wrappers for the /sbin/uci command, providing functions for managing UCI configurations such as loading, setting, reverting, and committing configurations in a Linux-based embedded device environment, specifically OpenWrt.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads the UCI configuration data for a specified package, exporting variables and executing a callback if defined.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if it is not already set.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts changes to a package's configuration state.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific state value for a package's configuration.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a state value for a package's configuration, effectively toggling the state.

methods.name: uci_set
methods.description: Sets a UCI option for a package, configuration, and option name.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list option within a UCI configuration.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value from a specified state directory.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Gets a UCI configuration value, with an optional default if the retrieval fails.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new configuration section or sets its type.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a specific configuration or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes an item from a list option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts changes to a specific package, configuration, and option.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to a specified UCI package.
